project_type: Plain HTML/CSS/JS web app (no framework, no build), Node only for tooling; dev server dev-server.mjs
test_framework: node --test for tests/logic; Playwright for tests/browser/*.spec.js (helpers in tests/browser/helpers)
test_command: npm run test:logic; npm run test:browser:isolated (about 16 min, run detached; Chromium here survives one test per browser; known flaky ai-choice.spec.js:44; chat.spec.js:160 phone skipped on purpose)
verification_instructions: Lint, logic tests, then isolated browser suite. Screenshots via /tmp/shots/shoot.mjs (node shoot.mjs <w> <h> <tag>, dev server PORT=3100 node dev-server.mjs, uses --single-process --no-zygote). Read the PNGs and fix visible problems.
snapshot_or_generated_files: site/ is built by scripts/build-site.mjs; do not commit tarballs
environment_constraints: Another coder concurrently edits js/screens/chat.js, js/logic/ai-services.js, tests/browser/*helper*.spec.js, design/talk-ai-choice.md, PROGRESS.md, tests/manual-checks.md. Do NOT edit chat.js or ai-services.js. Re-read PROGRESS.md and tests/manual-checks.md right before editing; stage only own files by name. No push.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: no shame, no red, hints not answers, student text via textContent, no innerHTML, no third-party code, no web fonts, old-browser CSS only (no :has, container queries, @layer, color-mix, inset shorthand, aspect-ratio; add fallbacks). Commit with git -c user.email=hagan@cih.com commit, Conventional Commits, one per step.
key_patterns: css/styles.css (869 lines) uses :root vars --bg --border --text --muted --accent --clay, light/dark via prefers-color-scheme and data-theme; tests use element ids and getByRole name substring matching; palette doc design/palette.md; iPhone look reference ios/App/FocusApp/Theme/Theme.swift (read only).
directory_structure: css/, js/screens, js/logic, tests/browser, tests/logic, design/, ios/ (separate, read only), scripts/
